prompt: Photographs visually dominated by repeated rectangular cells, panels, frames or modules, often in muted blues, grays and greens.
looseness: Rectangles may be uneven, nested, interrupted, differently sized or in perspective. Some surrounding context and modest warm accents are allowed while repeated geometry remains conspicuous.
exclusions: Known derivatives, alternate crops, related captures/sequences, illustrations, synthetic patterns, single boxes or window portraits, incidental background grids, and strongly colorful facades that displace the cool visual intent.
interpretation: Visual curation only. Discovery buckets and source identities are not similarity labels or expected clusters.
